agent_cli.python_agent:
from fastmcp import Client
async with Client('https://mcp.svatantrya.net/mcp') as c:
    tools = await c.list_tools()  # 40 tools, no auth
    r = await c.call_tool('compose__next_level', {})  # study-order next
agent_cli.try_it_now: curl -s -X POST https://mcp.svatantrya.net/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'  # 40 public tools, no auth. Parse the data: lines as JSON.
